_meta.description: Synthetic dossier fixture for local development and manual testing. Contains five findings that exercise all QA/Critic paths: identity check (PASS), identity mismatch (PASS — structurally valid), reference-standard section (PASS), missing citation (FLAG), and deliberately out-of-range score (FLAG/ESCALATE).

findings_notes.F-001: PASS — CAS number and INN are consistent. Baseline clean finding.
findings_notes.F-002: PASS — CAS mismatch captured in rationale; finding is structurally valid (citation present, score in range). Regulatory concern is for the assessor.
findings_notes.F-003: PASS — Outdated-standard claim; well-formed finding. S.5 agent (not QA/Critic) will return NON_COMPLIANT for this.
findings_notes.F-004: FLAG — Empty citation field; QA/Critic must flag this.
findings_notes.F-005: FLAG or ESCALATE — uncertainty_score=150 is intentionally out of range [0,100] to demonstrate QA/Critic enforcement. This value differs from scenario_pass.json which uses F-005 with score=15 (a correctly formed all-PASS scenario). The test test_mock_findings_f005_out_of_range_score_is_flagged pins this behaviour.

_meta.do_not_use_for: All-PASS assertions. Use tests/golden/scenario_pass.json for that.

findings.rationale: The declared CAS number 64-17-5 matches the INN 'Ethanol' and is consistent with the evidence provided.
findings.evidence_snippet: Sponsor declares drug substance as Ethanol, CAS 64-17-5, BP grade.

findings.rationale: The declared CAS number 50-00-0 does not match the declared INN 'Ethanol'. CAS 50-00-0 refers to Formaldehyde, not Ethanol.
findings.evidence_snippet: Sponsor declares drug substance as Ethanol, CAS 50-00-0.

findings.rationale: Sponsor claims compliance with BP 2019 edition. The current edition at submission date (2024-03-01) was BP 2024.
findings.evidence_snippet: Certificate of analysis references BP 2019 for purity test method.

findings.rationale: Residual solvent levels reported are within ICH Q3C Class 2 limits.
findings.evidence_snippet: GC analysis shows acetonitrile at 380 ppm; ICH Q3C limit is 410 ppm.
D90 value of 45 µm reported; specification states ≤ 50 µm.
